official.deadline_note: No single deadline exists because ULisbao publishes several distinct routes: DGES state scholarship applications run on the national BeOn timetable, university merit and PhD fellowship awards are published individually, and university residence applications are online and separate. SASULisboa publishes DGES scholarship application periods of 25 June to 30 September, the 20 working days after enrolment when enrolment occurs after 30 September, and the 20 working days after issue of the internship start certificate, with a possible pro-rata application between 1 October and 31 May.
official.status_note: ULisboa publishes no overall open call for international student support; support is delivered through several standing services - Student Support Services scholarships and financial aid, university residences, health and psychological support, academic success programmes - plus individually announced PhD fellowships and merit scholarships.
official.tuition_coverage_note: ULisboa's Tuition Fees page states the tuition fee is set annually by the General Council under Article 19(2)(h) of the University of Lisbon Statutes, that the 2026/2027 fee for bachelor's and integrated master's cycles is 697 EUR, that master's (2nd cycle) and doctoral (3rd cycle) fees vary from school to school, and that tuition fees for international students are those set out in the General Council Decision and indicated on each course page. The ULisboa international student brochure adds that the international student's tuition fee may be reduced to the same value as the one paid by Portuguese students, and to contact the school for that purpose.
benefits: Direct Social Support from ULisboa Student Support Services, including scholarships, financial aid and annual transport subsidies for students from Madeira and the Azores
Indirect Social Support including meals, accommodation, health services, cultural and sports activities
Special Support granted to students with special needs once their specific situation has been assessed

University residences: ULisboa has 15 residences with around 2,000 beds, open to bachelor's, integrated master's and master's students and to students in cooperation and mobility programmes, with priority to scholarship holders coming from outside Lisbon
Medical Center services and a psychological support hotline
SAS supplementary grant for each month of mobility for students of the Student Support Services, directly attributed by the DGES Student Support Services under communication from ULisacao

Academic Success at ULisboa: mentoring and tutoring, support for students with specific educational needs, support for students from Portuguese-speaking African countries, residence integration facilitators

Outward international sponsorship scholarships listed by ULisboa, including China master's, China Three Gorges Corporation (CTG), Swiss Confederation and DAAD awards, plus mobility through the Unite! European University Alliance
eligibility: Student Support Services are aimed at ensuring equal opportunities in access, attendance and academic success regardless of socio-economic background
Residence applications: bachelor's, integrated master's and master's students at ULisboa, and students in cooperation and mobility programmes, with priority to scholarship holders from outside Lisbon
Erasmus students who are Student Support Services scholarship holders must inform their school's International Relations or Erasmus Office to be awarded the supplementary mobility grant
PhD fellowships and merit scholarships published by ULisboa have their own individual eligibility conditions
requirements: DGES scholarship applications are made online via the DGES BeOn platform, with access credentials obtained through SASULisboa
The conditions for state scholarship support are set out in the Regulation of Allocation of Scholarships to Students of Higher Education (RABEEES)
documents: For DGES scholarship applications via BeOn: Citizen Card or Identity Card, Tax Identification Number (NIF), Social Security Identification Number (NISS), IRS declaration where submitted, IBAN for payment, land registry of properties owned or declared for Municipal Property Tax (IMI), and balances of current and future bank accounts referring to 31 December of the previous fiscal year plus remaining movable assets
Documents in a foreign language must be accompanied by a certified translation for the state scholarship route
selection_criteria: Direct and indirect social support is assessed against household financial resources, since the aim is to ensure equal opportunities regardless of socio-economic background
University merit and PhD fellowship schemes are published individually with their own selection conditions
coverage: DGES scholarships are paid directly by DGES to each student by bank transfer in 10 monthly instalments, except for exceptions provided by current legislation

Scholarship holders living in a SASULisboa residence are entitled to a monthly supplement equal to the monthly base amount paid by scholarship holders in the residences, up to a limit of 17.5% of the Index of Social Support
An SAS supplementary grant is available for each month of mobility
No statement of tuition coverage appears on the Student Support Services or scholarships pages
application_method: Obtain DGES BeOn access credentials through the SASULisboa website's 'Credentials Request' option
Complete and submit the scholarship application online in the BeOn platform within the published application period
For university merit scholarships and PhD fellowships, follow the individual award published on the ULisboa scholarships page
For accommodation, apply online through the university residence applications
official.application_route: There is no single route: DGES state scholarships go through the DGES BeOn platform with credentials from SASULisboa, while university awards and residences are published and applied for individually on ulisboa.pt.
official.citizenship_residency: Student Support Services exist for ULisboa students generally; the international student brochure states the international student's tuition fee may be reduced to the value paid by Portuguese students and that the corresponding school should be contacted. ULisboa describes itself as having around 9,000 international students from over 100 nationalities.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - international students are among the groups ULisbao's support structures serve, and the university publishes a dedicated international students brochure and a special admission contest for international students; eligibility for DGES state scholarships is set by national regulation rather than by ULisboa.
official.duration: DGES scholarship payments run in 10 monthly instalments per academic year; no duration is published for the university's own awards
official.description: The Student Support Services of Universidade de Lisboa is an autonomous service designed to carry out social action policies under the terms defined by law and by the university's governing bodies, providing and managing social services for students with the aim of ensuring equal opportunities in access, attendance and academic success regardless of socio-economic background, through direct and indirect social support and special support.
official.program_type: University social support structure comprising state scholarships, financial aid, residences, health and academic success services

verification.notes: The ulisboa.pt site refused direct page retrieval (HTTP 403 to automated fetching, several attempts including a browser session), so the record is built from ULisboa's own published pages as surfaced in search results, including the Student Support Services, Scholarships, International Scholarships, Tuition Fees and Social Services Supplementary Grants pages, the ULisba Student Guide and the official international student brochure PDF hosted on the ulisboa.pt domain, plus SASULisba's own scholarships page. Confidence is marked low for this reason and every figure that could not be read on an official ULisba page is left null.

applicant_utility.summary: There is no single scholarship here to apply for, so do not wait for one call: ULisbao routes international and domestic students through different doors - DGES state scholarships through the national BeOn platform with credentials issued by SASULisba, university merit and PhD fellowships published individually on the scholarships page, and residences applied for online with priority for scholarship holders from outside Lisbon. Two practical points matter most. First, tuition is not waived by any of these routes: the published 2026/2027 fee is 697 EUR for bachelor's and integrated master's cycles, master's and doctoral fees vary by school, and international fees are those set by the General Council Decision and listed on each course page - the brochure only says the international fee may be reduced to the Portuguese-student value, which is a request to the school, not an entitlement. Second, residence and grant cash is modest and time-bound: DGES scholarships are paid in 10 monthly instalments, and residence supplements are capped at 17.5% of the Index of Social Support.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Students already or soon enrolled at ULisba who need cash-flow help, accommodation or health support, particularly applicants from outside Lisbon with limited household resources and Erasmus students who are SASULischoa holders.
application_readiness_checklist: Request DGES BeOn access credentials through the SASULischoa website's 'Credentials Request' option as soon as you enrol
Apply for the DGES scholarship in BeOn inside the published period - 25 June to 30 September is the standard window, with the 20 working days after enrolment if you enrolled after 30 September
Apply separately for a university residence application online if you are coming from outside Lisbon, since priority goes to scholarship holders from outside Lisbon
If you are an Erasmus student holding a SASULischoa scholarship, tell your school's International Relations or Erasmus Office so the supplementary mobility grant is triggered
Check the individual award pages for PhD fellowships (Unite!, PRISC, Angola, Unite! Widening) and the Merit Scholarships, since each is published separately
Ask your intended school in writing about a reduction of the international tuition fee to the Portuguese-student value
common_rejection_risks: Assuming one university-level scholarship application covers DGES, merit, PhD and residence routes - they are separate
Missing the DGES BeOn window because you waited for enrolment, when the 20-working-day post-enrolment route only applies if you enrol after 30 September
Assuming tuition is covered: the only tuition-linked possibility is a discretionary reduction to the Portuguese-student value
Forgetting to notify the Erasmus Office, which forfeits the monthly supplementary mobility grant
Not preparing the full household financial documentation Seteple BeOn requires, including bank balances and IMI-declared properties
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition of at least 697 EUR per year for bachelor's and integrated master's cycles (higher and school-dependent for master's and doctoral cycles), plus living costs, since the awards are cash grants in 10 monthly instalments and the residence supplement is capped at 17.5% of the Index of Social Support.
document_audit: BeOn applications require Citizen Card or ID, NIF, NISS, IRS declaration if submitted, IBAN, IMI-declared property records and bank balance statements referring to 31 December of the previous fiscal year
Foreign-language documents need a certified translation for the DGES scholarship route
Phoney. PhD fellowship and merit scholarship requirements are set per award and are published with each call
Residence applications are online and separate from the scholarship application
alerts: The ULisboco website blocked automated retrieval during verification, so treat amounts, dates and rules as provisional and confirm them on the live site and on the DGES BeOn portal before applying
DGES scholarship payment is in 10 monthly instalments, which means no July-to-September income unless the legislation provides an exception
ULisblo advertises a psychological support hotline and a Medical Center in addition to financial support
The university is part of the Unite! European University Alliance, which carries its own mobility and fellowship routes
The international student brochure is hosted on the ulisboa.pt domain and is a reliable primary source for international-specific tuition rules
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Get BeOn credentials from SASULischoa, apply for the DGES scholarship in BeOn within the window, apply online for residence separately, contact your school about international tuition reduction, and monitor the ULisb scholarships page for individually announced merit and PhD fellowships.
